## Administrative responsibilities related to teaching

- **2020–present** — Member of the COPIL and COSP of EUR DS4H.
- **2022–2024** — Head of first-year Sociology (L1).
- **2022–2024** — Co-responsible with Isabella Feroni for Parcoursup and e-candidat.
- **2020–2024** — Responsible for Sociology undergraduate internships.
- **2020–2024** — Co-responsible with Manuel Boutet for the L@UCA programme for the UCA Sociology Department.
- **2020–2024** — Co-responsible with Manuel Boutet, Valérie Erlich and Gérald Gaglio for promotion of Sociology programmes at UCA.
- **2020–2023** — Responsible for the L.AS pathway for students enrolled in Sociology at UCA.
- **2020–2022** — Member of the COPIL, EUR ELMI.
- **2020–2021** — Alternate to the chair (Isabelle Feroni) of the pedagogical committee for the DECESF programme, Région Sud.
